content.text: The Boston Red Sox ride into the 2026 MLB season with confidence, hoping to build on their 89-73 record from last season, powered by young talents like Roman Anthony and Jarren Duran.MORE: MLB preseason power rankingsHow to Watch Boston Red Sox 2026 MLB Regular SeasonOpening Day: Thursday, March 26, 2026TV Channel: NESN (local); MLB.TV (out-of-market)AdvertisementYou can catch the Red Sox all season long with a subscription to Fubo. Regular-season games will be broadcast live locally on NESN and out-of-market on MLB.TV, both of which you can live stream with Fubo. The best part is that you can test out the services today for free.The Red Sox enter the 2026 season coming off an 89–73 record in 2025, a strong bounce-back year that saw them return to the postseason before being eliminated in the Wild Card round. The season marked real progress, as they snapped a multi-year playoff drought and reestablished themselves as a contender in a competitive AL East.Live Stream Boston Red Sox 2026 MLB GamesA major driver of that success was Jarren Duran, who put together a productive all-around season, hitting .256 with 16 home runs, 84 RBIs, and strong extra-base hit totals while providing speed and energy at the top of the lineup. His ability to impact the game both on the bases and in the outfield continues to make him a key piece of Boston’s core.AdvertisementAnother rising star is Roman Anthony, who emerged as one of the team’s most exciting young hitters, batting around .292 with a .396 OBP in his rookie campaign while flashing advanced plate discipline and middle-of-the-order potential. Heading into 2026, Boston’s outlook largely depends on that young core continuing to develop, with Anthony’s growth in particular giving the Red Sox a high ceiling as they look to build on last year’s postseason return.Live stream the Boston Red Sox during the 2026 MLB season with Fubo: Start your free trial now!Regional restrictions may apply.
